item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem: Meera's teacher asks the class about the calendar printed beside the Gregorian dates on the school notice board. Which statement correctly describes the Indian National Calendar?

options.A: It is an official solar calendar used by the Government of India along with the Gregorian calendar.
options.B: It is a lunar calendar in which each month begins at full moon.
options.C: It is used only for festivals and has no official use in India.
options.D: It is a 354-day calendar that ignores the position of the Sun.
